name: Max Power Mining Corp.
summary: Max Power Mining Corp., a junior mineral exploration company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of natural resource properties. It operates through Mineral Exploration Properties, and Research and Development segments. The company explores for lithium, nickel, cobalt, copper, platinum group element, and hydrogen deposits. It holds a portfolio of properties in the United States and Canada. Max Power Mining Corp. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Saskatoon, Canada.
